% Pattern: proof_status cited and omitted, and a claim inside a proof.
% want theorem-1 statement/theorem 1 status=cited origin=cited
% want theorem-2 statement/theorem 2 status=omitted
% want theorem-3 statement/theorem 3 status=here
% want proof-1 proof - proves=theorem-3
% want claim-1 statement/claim - parent=proof-1
\documentclass{article}
\usepackage{amsthm}
\newtheorem{theorem}{Theorem}
\newtheorem*{claim}{Claim}
\begin{document}
\begin{theorem}[{\cite[Theorem 4.1]{Rudin}}]
A known theorem.
\end{theorem}
\begin{theorem}
A routine result.
\end{theorem}
The proof is omitted.

\begin{theorem}
A new result.
\end{theorem}
\begin{proof}
\begin{claim}
A local claim.
\end{claim}
So it holds.
\end{proof}
\end{document}
